title: Corona Hi-Pot Tester 19055-C
seoDescription: Hi-pot tester with corona discharge detection (CDD), suited to EV motor test solutions.

props.title: Corona Hi-Pot Tester 19055-C
paragraphs: Hi-pot tester with corona discharge detection (CDD), suited to EV motor test solutions.

props.body:
- Hi-Pot: AC 5kV/100mA (4kV/120mA), DC 6kV/25mA
- Insulation: 5kVmax; 1MΩ ~ 50GΩ
- 500VA output rating
- Floating output complies with EN50191
- Corona Discharge Detection (CDD)
